stationary.description: static look-dev stage at 960x540, 8/16 internal: FULL and DRS controls, then 24 UP and 24 OWN frames interleaved (three jitter cycles each); the physical UI on both controls and on the last 8 frames of each

motion.description: the stage with the moving shadow-casting cube: 8 static frames, 6 of object motion, 6 with a camera pan; UP and OWN every step; FULL and DRS at steps 14 and 20

transitions.description: fractional offset viewport; UP and OWN in lockstep on the corrected schedule (the 16/16 segment now has the C9 fourth frame), separate 24-frame fixed-16/16 UP and OWN runs for C9's finite matched-cycle reference (frames 17-24), FULL and DRS 8/16 controls
transitions.schedule_correction: a5ae3179 had three 16/16 frames and could not measure the fourth; the minimum correction adds one 16/16 frame

c7_disocclusion.description: flat board: a white 0.5 m square 4 m from the eye, static for 8 frames, then 3 output pixels per frame over a 4-texel checker 6 m away; never-occluded reference with the square out of view; UP and OWN for both; FULL moving and reference at step 20

p1_crossing.description: flat grey board: a 0.8 m checker panel 4 m from the eye waits 8 frames, moves on frames 9-16 and stops; an orange bar 5 m from the eye moves every frame, crossing behind it and continuing after the stop; matched bar-free reference; UP and OWN for both; FULL with bar and reference at step 24

images.format: PNG, RGBA8, sRGB codes as read back

totals.counting: every scene, UI and readback queue submission is charged before it is attempted; each readback has exactly one map; controls, references and warmups are all counted; report.json fails unless the budget is consumed exactly. A numerical marker never substitutes for these budgets

outcome_rules.contract_checks: decide each process: adapter Metal, one owner per UP/OWN run with expected phases/history/epochs/internal sizes, attachment only on OWN, control plainness, UI interior identity (stationary), chrome identity (transitions), measurable C7/P1 regions, nonblank frames, exact budget
outcome_rules.historical_threshold_observations: the unchanged C7 and C9 threshold values are compared with tone-mapped 8-bit sRGB rendered output and recorded in report.json as rendered-output observations, not passes or fails of the historical linear-model gates; an undefined comparison (nonfinite or nonpositive denominator, empty or nonfinite region) is null, never a pass; they never decide the process outcome
outcome_rules.observations: error and activity statistics, chart contrast, wire presence, P1 residuals: never decide anything
outcome_rules.quality_judgment: Claude's later inspection of the retained PNGs, separate from all numbers
